name: animated-number
title: Animated Number
description: Displays a single large number that animates toward any new value with a spring and comma formatting, with a row of pill buttons in the demo to pick targets.
use: A stat, balance or count changes and you want the eye to follow the move instead of a jump.
avoid: Numbers update many times a second; the spring lags behind live data and reads as jitter.
a11y: The changing number is a plain span with no aria-live region, so screen readers do not announce updates. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One oversized white number sits centred on black, using tabular figures and comma separators. Under it, five grey rounded pill buttons show 0, 999, 1,234, 42,000 and 1,000,000.
behaves: Choosing a pill makes the number spring from its old value to the new one, counting through intermediate values before it settles.
customise: value drives the number; format, precision, mass, stiffness and damping are props, while colours and size come from the parent.
weight: light: One spring value and a text transform; no layout work.
